title: Mycelium, grapes and wine brewing
body:
Deep underground, Mycelium can be found growing on stone. Keep it in a dark place and it spreads like grass and grows mushrooms on top.

Grapes can be found in dungeon chests. They're not a good food item, but you can plant them on fences to grow more. Goblets can also be found in dungeon chests.

Put grapes, mushrooms, a goblet and an ingredient of your choice into a Cask to produce up to 10 different flavours of wine, each giving a different potion effect. Brewing a single goblet takes an entire in-game day, so you'll want multiple casks. Maybe a lot of them.
